name: Explicit Credential Logon Then Share Accessed
description: A logon using explicitly supplied credentials (4648) is followed by a network share being accessed (5140) — the runas-then-reach-a-share shape of hands-on-keyboard lateral movement. 4648 is broad: ordinary runas, scheduled tasks and service accounts all emit it, and 5140 is only recorded at all where file-share object auditing is enabled. Treat a match as a lead to inspect.
